items.t: BlackBerry and Hazard Management Cayman Islands Renew Critical Alerting System for Emergencies and Public Safety
items.sum: The NENS app, powered by AtHoc, enables HMCI to issue official warnings and safety information about major emergencies, including hurricanes, tropical storms, earthquakes, and tsunami threats. Registered users can receive official alerts through the AtHoc app, SMS and/or email, depending on their registration settings.
